It also appears in [[The Classic Event]] missions as part of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It has a high amount of health, though it is quite slow, only being faster than the [[Korblox Warrior (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Warrior]] and [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Deathwalker]]. It could spawn with [[Bloated]], [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]] on certain waves. ==Logbook Description== "''From the Ice Heart tribe, the Korblox General is among the most powerful units in The Korblox Empire. Admired for their ferocity and strength, these generals could singlehandedly destroy a small army. The low-ranking members of the empire kneel before them as the screams of their enemies echo from their bodies.''" ==Appearance== The '''Korblox General''' is a giant skeleton that floated above the path. It has a grey skull with neon blue eyes. It also has neon blue arms and has no torso or legs. It wears grey pants, chestplate and shoulder-pads. It also has metal armbands and multiple blue spikes on its armor. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Korblox Temple]] is listed instead. *Multiple early-game towers, like the [[Militant]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Medic]] or [[Brawler]] can be useful against this. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Turret]] or [[Accelerator]] can kill this quite quickly. *As the '''Korblox General''' has multiple immunities on certain waves, it is significantly harder to slow down. **It cannot be frozen, chilled or knocked back by towers. Additionally, stuns only slow it down instead of fully stunning it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxGeneralLevitation.gif|Walking animation (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGeneral.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} The Hunt- Mega Edition Trailer -
